summary: Polyrizon Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a registered offering of 232,500 ordinary shares at $12.00 per share and 30,000 pre-funded warrants at $11.99999 each, plus a concurrent unregistered PIPE of pre-funded warrants and five-year warrants exercisable at $12.00. Aegis Capital Corp. serves as exclusive placement agent on a best-efforts basis, receiving 8% fees. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, with proceeds before expenses of approximately $2.9 million. The offering has no minimum or escrow conditions.
